ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَعْمَالِنَا خَوَاتِيْمَهَا ، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِنَا يَوْمَ لِقَائِكَ ،
tr: Allāhumma ‘j`al khayra a`mālinā khwātīmahā, Wa khayra ayyāminā yawma liqā’ika,
en: O Allah, make the best of our works their seal and the best of our days the Day we meet You!

ar: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُوْرَنَا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ إِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ۝۸
tr: Rabbanā atmim lanā nūra nā wa ‘ghfir lanā, Inna ka `alā kulli shay’in Qadīr.
en: Our Lord, complete our light for us and forgive us, surely You are Capable of all things!

ar: رَبَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا بِمَآ اَنْزَلْتَ وَ اتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ ۝۵۳
tr: Rabbanā āmannā bi mā anzalta wa ‘t-taba`nā ‘r-Rasūla fa ‘ktubnā ma`a ‘sh-Shāhidīn,
en: Our Lord, we believe in what You sent and followed the Messenger, so write us among the witnesses!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا قَدَّمْنَا وَ مَا أَخَّرْنَا وَ مَا أَسْرَرْنَا وَ مَا أَعْلَنَّا وَ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنَّا .
tr: Allāhumma ‘ghfir lanā mā qaddamnā wa mā akhkharnā wa mā asrarnā wa mā a`lannā wa mā anta a`lamu bi hī minnā.
en: O Allah, forgive us what we sent forth, what we left behind, what we hid, what we showed and whatever You know of us!
